name: Tarai Foods Limited
about: Tarai Foods Limited manufactures and sells frozen fruits and vegetables using individual quick frozen (IQF) freezing Technology in India. It provides frozen peas, frozen sweet corn, and frozen mixed vegetables. The company also offers fresh, frozen, and canned mushrooms, as well as mushrooms and their spawn. Tarai Foods Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Rudrapur, India.
